newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi minister of state is expected to arrive in Iran on Tuesday carrying a letter from King Fahd to Iranian president.
- Saudi interior minister arrived in Yemen for talks on border dispute between Saudi Arabia and Yemen.
- Jordanian Chamber of Commerce Union is forming a team to meet Palestinian businessmen.
- Kuwaiti economic development fund lends Jordan 10 million dinars to finance a water project in the capital.
- Saudi industrial exports increased to 15.4 billion riyals in 1994 from 1.2 billion in 1984, industry and electricity minister said.
- Private investments in Arab countries stood at $2.1 billion in 1996, up 38.5 percent from a year earlier.
